description: This Go source file implements a CLI command for stopping an agent node in the AgentField control plane. It includes command creation, process termination logic (via HTTP shutdown or signals), and registry management.

classes.name: AgentNodeStopper
classes.description: Handles stopping agent nodes, including process termination and registry updates.

methods.name: runStopCommand
methods.description: Executes the stop command with provided arguments, initiating the stopping process.

methods.name: StopAgentNode
methods.description: Stops a running agent node by attempting HTTP shutdown or process signals, then updates the registry.

methods.name: loadRegistry
methods.description: Loads the agent node installation registry from a YAML file.

methods.name: saveRegistry
methods.description: Saves the updated registry back to the YAML file.
